title: Two KUNG MACH builds just under 8 kg
notes: A builder reports assembling a silver size-L MACH with 105 Di2 R7170 and a black-gold size-XS MACH with 105 R7120, both just under 8 kg, and praises easy internal routing through the matching bar. Weighing basis, wheels and pedals not stated.

capture.scope: Archived public post; the selected photos were reviewed from the original files, which remain outside Git.
